zh: 多条笔画在图像中央附近交叉。
左侧组向上分叉，并继续形成向下的斜向笔画。
右侧组围出一个小的倒三角形开口。
一条弧形笔画从中央连接处向右上方延伸。
中央连接处下方有一条短竖向笔画。
来源元数据预期有六张图，但当前只有一张本地复核图；仍需获取另外五张来源视图。
en: Several strokes cross near the center of the image.
The left group forks upward and continues into a diagonal lower stroke.
The right group forms a small inverted triangular opening.
A curved stroke rises from the central junction toward the upper-right.
A short vertical stroke descends below the central junction.
Source metadata expects six images, but only one local review image is present; five source views still need retrieval.
These observations describe visible marks only; no component, variant, or reading is assigned.
